name: Box Turtle
description: Box Turtle is an open-source, AMS-style lane-based automated filament changer for Klipper 3D printers. Each lane has its own dedicated NEMA14 stepper motor for filament drive and an N20 DC motor for electric respooling. All lanes merge at a hub/combiner. Designed to deliver a Bambu AMS-like experience for any Klipper printer, with VORON Design printers as the primary target. Available in 4-lane and 8-lane variants using custom AFC-Lite or AFC-Pro controller boards.
features: AMS-style filament changing for any Klipper printer
Electric respoolers with low drag top-fed design
Filament cutter support (FilamATrix, hub cutter, or tip-forming)
Waste management options: poop/kick/wipe purging or prime towers
Per-lane prep and load sensors plus hub switch
